summary: The agent provides a strong solution overall, implementing comprehensive feature engineering, a diverse set of models (including a custom ResNet with Focal/Ranking loss), and an optimized blending ensemble. However, it computes some global statistics and fits several transformers (like TF-IDF and median imputation) on the full training set before the cross-validation loop. While this doesn't leak test data, it introduces data leakage between the CV training and validation folds.
